meta.verification: Every Agave Harmonic day checked against that day's own client roll-up at reports.firedancer.io: avg_fee 30/30 within 0.1 pct (median ratio 1.00000), avg_tip at 6 pct 30/30 within 0.1 pct. Blocks run 0.1-1.0 pct light; Dune omits a few blocks a day, which does not move per-block means.
meta.basis: Percentiles are computed from exact 0.5 mSOL histograms, so ANY date range pools exactly. Jito's 6 pct commission is measured, not assumed: gross tip-account inflow over the report's figure was 1.0638 for all 73 validators on 2026-09-07, stdev 1e-7.
meta.like_note: Both cohorts are compared on fee + Jito tip net of 6 pct. GBX additionally collects Titan/Bifrost tips on routes Agave Harmonic never touches (zero inflow across 62,151 slots on 2026-09-07); those are reported separately and excluded from comparisons.
meta.sankey_note: The Sankey follows gross inflow to its destinations. Jito takes 6 pct of tips before the TipDistributionAccount; the validator then keeps its MEV commission of the remainder and stakers get the rest. Fees are kept in full: priority_fee_commission_bps is 10000 for every validator in both cohorts. Commission is block-weighted per day from each day's report blocks and Kobe's per-epoch mev_commission_bps.
caveats: No post-connection filter on GBX: only 4 of 11 validators had connected on 2026-08-11, reaching 11 by 2026-09-02.
Cohort sizes differ about fivefold (11 vs 47-61 validators), so operator quality, stake and datacenter mix are uncontrolled.
p96-p100 rest on single-digit slot counts on short ranges and swing hard; p5-p95 is the usable band.
Harmonic membership is resolved per day, since 35 of 75 validators come and go.
meta.trimmed_note: Means on the cards are TRIMMED to p1-p99: slots below the 1st and above the 99th percentile are dropped, matching the reference card's 'tail values outside p1-p99 excluded'. Computed from exact per-bin SOL sums, not bin midpoints, so only the two boundary bins are apportioned.
